messages:
phil_sales: Heads-up — FinCo legal says they need SIG/CAIQ + executed SCCs before we kick off the Dedicated POC. Also asked if we can commit to 30-day data deletion and whether we’ll accept their DPA redlines. Pricing ask: they want a 3-month discounted reserved pool for the POC.

alice_privacy: @phil_sales thanks. Quick clarifying q: when they say 30-day deletion do they mean token logs + KV cache + customer-uploads?

phil_sales: Their note: "all personal data created during the POC (logs, uploaded files, and inference traces) must be deletable on 30d notice; DSARs handled within 30 days". They specifically called out inference traces.

miranda_legal: We can accept 30-day deletion for hosted data and uploads; inference traces are covered if we treat them as logs. Caveat: our standard DPA has 90d logs retention for incident analysis. If we shorten to 30d for this deal we need a documented exception and sign-off from security. Also SCCs: we need to propose Controller-Processor wording — do they want us as processor?

jordan_solutions: They want Redwood to be processor (they're controller). Fine. They also asked for subprocessors list and whether any devops SSO access exists.

sam_eng: For Dedicated POC (reserved GPUs) we can run in their VPC (private deployment) which keeps logs on their network — that helps deletion. For hosted trial, KV cache and prefix caching are on our infra by default. Deleting KV cache immediately is doable via a purge API but requires coordination.

eve_sec: Security note: if we accept 30d deletion for hosted, we need to change log retention and update our observability playbook — that affects incident forensics. I'd prefer private deployment for their requirement.

phil_sales: Customer is ok with private deployment but wants a fast onboarding window (2 weeks). Are there infra blockers for a short private POC?

sam_eng: 2 weeks is tight but doable if we provision a minimal cluster and skip full monitoring. Would need SOC sign-off for reduced telemetry.

miranda_legal: On DPA redlines — share the redlines and I can mark acceptable vs. non-starters. For SCCs we should propose the EU Commission modules plus our standard annex. Also need vendor-risk questionnaire answers for SIG/CAIQ — I can prep high-level answers, but security needs to verify technical controls.

eve_sec: I'll run the SIG answers. Important flags: key management (we support KMS/HSM for Private, hosted uses our KMS), subprocessors (list and dates), incident notification SLA (we can offer 72h initial notice + 30d root-cause).

jordan_solutions: Pricing: they asked for a 20% discount on Dedicated POC (3 months). Can we offer a one-time promo?

phil_sales: Need guidance — if Private then pricing should include infra costs plus onboarding. Is discount ok as a POC incentive?

miranda_legal: Pricing is fine to negotiate, but exception details must be in SOW. For data commitments, if they insist on 30d deletion for hosted we need explicit technical appendix describing deletion scope and verification method.

sam_eng: Suggestion: propose this two-track plan to them: (1) Private POC in their VPC — meets deletion + KV control, 2-week spin-up, 10% discount + onboarding fee waived. (2) Hosted POC with contractual 30d deletion exception — requires security & legal approval; 20% discount. Ask which they prefer.

phil_sales: I'll draft an email. Miranda/Eve/Sam: can you each drop 1-paragraph bullets I can paste for the customer? Trying to keep it short.

miranda_legal: Miranda: We can sign DPA with 30-day deletion addendum scoped to POC only. Need redlines and subprocessors list. SCCs will be the EU standard set.

eve_sec: Eve: Private deployment is recommended; hosted with 30d deletion is a negotiable exception but reduces available telemetry for post-incident processes. We maintain KMS for hosted; consider customer-managed keys for higher assurance.

sam_eng: Sam: We can provision private POC in ~10 business days if they approve minimal monitoring. Purge APIs available to delete KV/cache/logs on request; will provide runbook and verification steps.

phil_sales: Great — posting draft now and pinging them. Will attach the SOC/SIG answers once @eve_sec finishes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
